title: VTC Badges — Awards — List — payload
description: The owners' view of a badge: every award of it, a page at a time, each recipient projected as the directory projects them and marked where they hid the badge. The outer document members are owned by the framework — SPEC §6.3.

state.description: Only awards in this state. Absent: every state.

entryId.description: Only awards to this member. Absent: every recipient.

cursor.description: An opaque continuation token from a previous response's `nextCursor`, bound to the caller, the badge and the filters; a responder MUST NOT accept a cursor it did not issue.

limit.description: The most items to return, at most 200; the responder chooses a default (50) and MAY return fewer.

Response.title: VTC Badges — Awards — List — response payload
Response.description: The success response to a vtc/badges/awards/list/0.1 request. Carried in a Trust Task document whose type is https://trusttasks.org/spec/vtc/badges/awards/list/0.1#response.

hidden.description: True where the recipient has hidden this badge (VTI-BDG-030): off their wall, out of the holder list and its count; the award, the membership and the credential stand.

fields.description: The recipient's directory fields the caller may see, projected exactly as vtc/directory/entries/show would project them. Absent when the caller may see none.

nextCursor.description: Continuation token for the next page; pass it back as `cursor`. Absent on the last page — never `null`.
